Headquartered in Barcelona, Spain
Medichem
is a
vertically integrated B2B pharmaceutical and CDMO partner
specializing in ~45 Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and 20 Finished Dosage Forms (FDFs), alongside global leadership in antiseptic products like Chlorhexidine.
Medichem
Core Product Portfolio & Focus Areas
Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs):
~45 generic small-molecule APIs covering various therapeutic areas.
Finished Dosage Forms (FDFs):
~20 oral and injectable ready-to-use finished products.
Antiseptics & Disinfectants:
World-leading supplier of Chlorhexidine-based formulations for pharmaceutical, personal, and home care sectors.
Medichem
Major Manufacturer & Commercial Partners
Somerset Therapeutics:
Active license and supply agreements focusing on specialized, complex injectable formats and spray-drying technology for the U.S. generic market.
PharmaSource
Azelis:
Distribution partner managing the commercial expansion of Medichem's antiseptic and chlorhexidine solutions across the DACH region and pan-European markets.
Azelis
Breckenridge Pharmaceutical:
Strategic collaboration partner helping distribute and commercialize cost-effective generic products within the United States.
